text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Do the voices of the people reach you? 
Though we are apart, their loyalty still 
rings in our ears.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My victory is beyond doubt, and none shall 
stand in the path of my supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narrowing her eyes slightly, Orfevre 
listened to the voices of the multitude 
echoing from the distant stands.
